lines.t: [Intimate, sparse acoustic guitar intro]
When the room goes quiet… and no one knows
Who am I… behind the door?
When the praise is gone… and the lights go low
What am I living for?
I can wear a smile… like borrowed clothes
Say the words… they want to hear
But You see the parts… I hide away
You see what’s really here
Make me the same… in the dark and light
When no one’s watching… and when I’m in sight
Take every mask… I’ve learned to wear
Leave only truth… leave only prayer
I don’t want two faces… I want one heart
Whole before You… just as I am
I know my mouth… can speak too fast
Let little storms… become a fire
I know my hands… can reach for things
That pull me from… what You desire
Every secret… I thought was mine
Is open like the morning sky
You never turn… Your eyes away
Still You are calling me
Make me the same… in the dark and light
When no one’s watching… and when I’m in sight
Take every mask… I’ve learned to wear
Leave only truth… leave only prayer
I don’t want two faces… I want one heart
Whole before You… just as I am
If I say Your name… but don’t obey
Turn my wandering steps Your way
I don’t want a faith for crowds
I want You… in the quiet now
Make me the same… in the dark and light
When no one’s watching… and when I’m in sight
Take every mask… I’ve learned to wear
Leave only truth… leave only prayer
I don’t want two faces… I want one heart
Whole before You… just as I am
Behind the door…
You still see me…
One heart…
Before You.
